input.rationale: Section 12(b) limits TrueLink's indemnity to claims arising out of its own breach of the Agreement or failure to perform its obligations; there is no indemnity for third-party allegations that the Interface or hosted services infringe intellectual property rights (and no non-infringement warranty anywhere else in the Agreement — the only infringement covenants run in TrueLink's favour or against Client at §§ 2 and 8(e)). That fails even the fallback, which requires a vendor IP indemnity, while Client's indemnity in § 12(a) is broad (Client breach, Web Site/Client Content, and injury or damage from anything transmitted from the Web Site). We therefore inserted a new § 12(c) giving the preferred vendor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorised access to Client Content/Credit Data and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice/control/cooperation procedure and Client Content and Client-modification carve-outs. We have left § 12(a) as drafted rather than narrowing it, keeping the edit minimal.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink IP infringement / misconduct indemnity with standard defence procedure
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity at Section 12(b) covers only its own breach of this Agreement, so it leaves us exposed on third-party IP infringement claims against the Interface and hosted services we are required to use. We have added the vendor-side IP, breach-of-law, data-breach and wilful misconduct indemnity with the usual notice/control/cooperation procedure and carve-outs for Client Content and Client modifications; an IP-only indemnity with the customary exclusions and remedies would be our fallback.

ops.text: c. Without limiting Section 12(b), TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable provided by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall promptly notify the indemnifying party of any such claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement thereof (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. TrueLink's obligations under clause (i) shall not apply to the extent the claim arises from Client Content or from Client's modification of the Interface contrary to TrueLink's written instructions.
